seo.title: Privacy Policy — VoiceBridge Pro
seo.description: How VoiceBridge Pro collects, uses, and protects your family's data. We never sell your data and communication content stays private.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.intro: VoiceBridge Pro is built for families. We treat your data — and especially your family's communication data — with the utmost care and transparency.

summary.title: The Short Version
items: We never sell your data or your family's communication content.
Communication logs are visible only to you and caregivers you authorize.
You can request deletion of your account and all data at any time.
We use minimal data — only what's needed to run the service.

content.subtitle: Account Information
content.text: When you create a VoiceBridge Pro account, we collect your name, email address, and account type (parent, caregiver, or therapy center). This information is necessary to create and manage your account.

content.subtitle: Profile Information
content.text: You may add profiles for the individuals who use the communication board (name, photo, and preferred language). This information is used solely to personalize the app experience.

content.subtitle: Communication Data
content.text: VoiceBridge Pro logs card taps and communication events to provide the history and notification features. This data includes timestamps, card titles, and phrases — it is tied to individual profiles and visible only to authorized account holders.

content.subtitle: Device & Usage Information
content.text: We collect basic technical information such as device type, operating system, and app version to maintain service quality and diagnose issues. We do not use this data for advertising.

content.subtitle: To Provide the Service
content.text: We use your information to operate the VoiceBridge Pro platform — delivering real-time notifications, maintaining communication logs, and personalizing the board experience.

content.subtitle: To Improve the App
content.text: Aggregate, anonymized usage patterns help us understand which features are most valuable and where we can improve. Individual communication content is never used for this purpose.

content.subtitle: To Communicate With You
content.text: We may send you service-related emails such as account confirmations, security alerts, and product updates. You can opt out of non-essential communications at any time.

content.subtitle: We Never Sell Your Data
content.text: VoiceBridge Pro does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information or your family's communication data to any third party, ever.

content.subtitle: Service Providers
content.text: We work with a small number of trusted infrastructure providers (cloud hosting, push notification delivery) who process data strictly on our behalf under confidentiality agreements.

content.subtitle: Legal Requirements
content.text: We may disclose information if required by law, regulation, or a valid legal process. We will notify you when legally permitted to do so.

content.subtitle: Therapy Centers
content.text: If a parent links a profile to a therapy center account, the therapy center can view that profile's board and communication history. This sharing is initiated and controlled by the parent.

content.subtitle: Encryption
content.text: All data is transmitted over encrypted connections (TLS). Data at rest is encrypted using industry-standard protocols on our cloud infrastructure.

content.subtitle: Access Controls
content.text: Access to your data is restricted by role-based permissions. Only you and the caregivers you authorize can view your family's communication data.

content.subtitle: Incident Response
content.text: In the unlikely event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we will notify you promptly and take immediate steps to contain and remediate the issue.

content.subtitle: Accounts for Adults Only
content.text: VoiceBridge Pro accounts are created and managed by adults (parents, caregivers, or therapy professionals). We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children.

content.subtitle: Profile Data
content.text: Information added to a child's profile (name, photo, communication history) is entered by an adult account holder and is protected under that account's privacy settings.

content.subtitle: Access & Correction
content.text: You can view and update your account information and profile data at any time from within the app.

content.subtitle: Data Deletion
content.text: You may request deletion of your account and all associated data by contacting us at info@mstechlabs.com. We will process your request within 30 days.

content.subtitle: Data Export
content.text: You may request an export of your communication history and account data. Contact us at info@mstechlabs.com to submit a request.

content.subtitle: Notification of Updates
content.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notice. Continued use of VoiceBridge Pro after the effective date of a revision constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: Questions about this policy?
contact.description: We're happy to answer any questions about how we handle your data.
